content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alerts: sustained p95/p99 latency increase observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~1781234500. Error rate still low, but tail latency > 5s for multiple customers. Paging oncall.
Alisha: Oncall here — joining the bridge now (link in calendar). quick note: taking lead for triage.
Miguel: On it, starting with runtime logs and autoscaler metrics. ping me if you want me to mute non-essential alerts.
Alisha: @Miguel put any high-volume logs in the incident slack thread. we'll capture timeline and hypotheses here.
Samir: grabbing pod logs and queue sizes. running: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/rt-frontend --tail 200`
Samir: logs snippet: ```
I 2026-03-15T15:02:34.123Z request_id=abc123 start processing
I 2026-03-15T15:02:34.567Z request_id=abc123 kv_cache: miss
W 2026-03-15T15:02:36.890Z request_id=abc123 backend_latency=4200ms
E 2026-03-15T15:02:37.001Z request_id=abc123 stderr=timed out waiting for GPU response
```
Jordan: seeing repeated `kv_cache: miss` + GPU timeout. could be cache invalidation causing cold starts? or kernel contention.
Miguel: Autoscaler shows a brief scale event at 15:01:40, then lots of small pods spun up. Pod start time ~5-7s, but requests kept routing to older pods until new pods warmed.
Alisha: Customer impact check: Emily, can you validate which customers saw increased latency? we need names for comms.
Emily: Pulling mapping now. Partial list: beta-corp (internal RL app), docsflow, searchly. Impact window looks like 15:01:20 - 15:06:00 UTC. Some requests hit 10-12s.
Alisha: Draft status page (v0): 
---
Status: Investigating
Service: Redwood Inference (API) - us-west-2
Impact: Increased request latency for text generation; a subset of customers experienced slow responses (5-12s).
Start: 2026-03-15 15:01 UTC
Action: Oncall investigating, collecting logs and metrics.
---
Emily: ping @support and @cs-esc to prep customer outreach. I can post v0 to statuspage once we lock impact window and affected customers.
Samir: hypothesis list: 1) KV cache invalidation after deployment/scale 2) autoscaler churn routing to cold pods 3) model worker queue backlog due to kernel scheduling.
Jordan: quick test: are model workers showing increased GC or oom-restarts? `kubectl get pods -n model | grep worker` shows no restarts. CPU spiking on a subset of hosts though.
Miguel: adding trace snippet from envoy showing long downstream time for a few client IPs — looks correlated with pod start times.
Alisha: Mitigation for now: 1) pin routing to warm pool for critical customers 2) bump minimum replicas to reduce churn 3) enable fallback model variant for very low-latency SLAs. Who can flip min replicas? @Miguel?
Miguel: I can increment min replicas to 4 in us-west-2. Doing `k8s scale` now.
Miguel: Ran: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/rt-frontend --replicas=4` -> applied. I'll watch for reduced tail latency.
Samir: I've exported the raw logs to /incidents/1781234567/logs.tar.gz and started a short grep for `backend_latency` spikes.
Alisha: Good. We'll keep the bridge for 30m then hand off to async. Please add timeline bullets here as you find them.
Jordan: Timeline (WIP):
 - 15:00:58 UTC: autoscaler triggered scale-up event in us-west-2
 - 15:01:10 UTC: small deployment event detected (controller updated replicas)
 - 15:01:20 UTC: first user-reported slow request (10s+)
 - 15:02:30 UTC: p95/p99 alerts fired
 - 15:03:40 UTC: oncall bridged; mitigation: increase min replicas
 - 15:05:00 UTC: tail latency trending down after new pods warmed
Emily: For stakeholder comms: suggested message for execs: "We experienced elevated latency between 15:01-15:06 UTC in us-west-2 due to autoscaler churn causing requests to hit un-warmed pods. Mitigation applied and service is recovering. RCA in progress." Thoughts?
Alisha: fine for execs. For customers, softer language and include affected customers list and next steps (postmortem + follow-up).
Miguel: Confirming metrics: p99 went from 4500ms -> 900ms within ~3 minutes of scaling change. Monitoring shows stable.
Samir: leaving grep artifacts and raw logs in the incident folder. I'll annotate suspicious traces with request_ids.
incident-bot: Note: bridge closed by Alisha at 15:28 UTC. Async follow-up thread created: https://redwood/threads/1781234567/async-rca
Alisha: Closing live bridge. Handoff: Jordan to lead async timeline + initial RCA draft; Samir to collect traces and correlate request_ids; Miguel to produce infra mitigation plan (min replica policy + warm pool); Emily to post statuspage v1 in ~10m after I approve.
Emily: Posting statuspage v1 now with impact window and affected customers. Will link to incident doc once Jordan posts the timeline.
Jordan: Starting RCA doc in the incidents drive: /incidents/1781234567/rca.md — will include hypotheses, evidence, mitigation, and follow-ups. Please add any logs or notes.
Alisha: Thanks team. Good coordination. If anything regresses, page again. :thumbsup:
